title: Polymeric sorbent phase sorptive extraction for radiation metabolomics

Abdul Hoque, Evan L. Pannkuk, Jerome Lacombe, Sunil Bansal, Jerry Angdisen, Geraldine Vitry, Abel Encarnacion Hernandez, Nabhan M. Fakrudin, Mathew Barrett, James Helton, Jian Gu, Albert J. Fornace, Evagelia C. Laiakis, Frederic Zenhausern
A multi-functionalized sorbent coated membrane was developed for extraction and stabilization of biomarkers from biofluids. Our SPSE membrane showed excellent stability up to 14 days for serum-based biomarkers such as carnitine, hypoxanthine etc.
